hooks.name: Secret Leakage Guard
hooks.description: Asks for confirmation before git add/commit commands that reference .env, .env.local, or files that look like credential stores.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=(d.get('tool_input') or d.get('toolInput') or {}); cmd=c.get('command','') if isinstance(c,dict) else str(c); is_git=bool(re.search(r'git\s+(add|commit)\b',cmd)); secret=bool(re.search(r'\.env(\.local|\.[a-z]+\.local)?\b|credentials|secrets?\.(json|ya?ml|env)|\.pem\b|id_rsa', cmd, re.I)); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'permissionDecision':'ask','permissionDecisionReason':'Git command references a file that may contain secrets; confirm it is not a real credential before staging/committing.'}})) if (is_git and secret) else None; sys.exit(0)"
